A quick roundup of the most important platform improvements, new capabilities, and fixes shipping soon. For further information, see our full monthly platform updates.
We’d love to hear from you! Your feedback helps us improve our products and shape what comes next, so please take a moment to share your thoughts and ideas.
Project-Based Agents
Last week, we highlighted that we would soon release project-based agents. You will be able to set this up when creating a new project by selecting the Agent Coordinator option, giving you a dedicated AI teammate that knows the content, takes on work and keeps things moving, even when you are offline. Your AI teammate can analyze project data, build internal dashboards or prepare documents, using data from the project.

Spotlight: Web App Builder
The Abacus.AI Agent web application builder is a general-purpose feature that builds full-stack web and mobile apps from a single prompt with no coding required. It generates the frontend, backend, user authentication and payment or data integrations directly from your description. It combines leading foundation models like GPT-6 Astra, Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon in one workspace. Watch our demo.
